Name: Busty Farmer
Author: ChewyZ
Description:
Well-endowed farmgirls are a classic. This basically makes all the shirts low-cut with plenty of cleavage when worn by the female farmer.

Untested with non-vanilla shirts, but should still work. (Cleavage is drawn along with the arms, which display on top of shirts.) Let me know if there are any modded clothes that look strange with this.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4481]Oppai Valley[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5335]Change Dialogues[/url]. And of course, thank you to all the other busty/buxom NPC mods out there.
